decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w2' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9757. Series context: trend strength 0.0 and seasonal strength 0.2577; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.232); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.618.
